annotations.annotation_text: Page 400 opens Book 3, Chapter 1 ("Unknown") during the Unknown phase. This passage continues the nocturnal dream, featuring HCE, ALP. The nocturnal dream-narrative layers Dublin topography, world mythology, and linguistic alchemy into polysemic prose.
sources: Campbell, Joseph and Robinson, Henry Morton. A Skeleton Key to Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/skeletonkeytofin00camp
